items.Sentence: The Parkwood WWTF consists of a wet/dry well followed by a manual bar screen, aeration tank, clarifier, and sludge drying beds prior to wastewater disposal in one of three unlined percolation/evaporation ponds as shown on Attachment B - Site Plan Map.
